Needs changes before merge.

The drill depth, stock simulation, MCP fields, and old-file migration passed the checks below. Two required items are missing.

Required before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:84`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Show the Levels controls and the new `Break-through from` selector. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body.
2. `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:127`: Declare the project-format change as a breaking change. The format changes from v67 to v68, and older readers must refuse the new files. None of the PR commits has `!` or a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Add a new conventional commit with that declaration and explain the reader limit in the PR body. This is required by current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under “Commits and Releases”. Keep the existing history.

Local results:

All checks ran on this machine in `.claude/worktrees/review-2504`, with the PR trial-merged with upstream main `e2ed62d0bfe554207d83a47c71818457cf0be6ca`. The merge was clean. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. The full quick gate was not run.

The UI failure is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. The local graphics system reports:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter
metal found no adapters
```

The new selector test and the existing break-through control and command-history tests passed. Pixel snapshot tests stayed ignored.

Strict Clippy, for all targets of the four touched crates, failed at an unchanged line:

```text
error: the borrowed expression implements the required traits
  --> crates/app/src/operation/heights.rs:128:18
128 |             .map(&resolve)
```

I also ran `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib -- -D warnings` on upstream main alone. It failed with the same error at the same line. After I restored the trial merge, Clippy passed for all targets of all four touched crates with `-D warnings -A clippy::needless_borrows_for_generic_args`. The strict check is not green. This existing warning and the missing graphics adapter are not added to the two requested changes.

Safety checks:

- I removed the added point length from `cycle.rs` in the disposable review tree. `issue_2441_through_hole_drill_adds_point_length_and_posts_full_breakthrough` failed: `deepest tip must include the 118 deg drill point (-2.803), got -1.000`. I restored the code, and the test passed.
- I disabled the drill-cone branch in `stock_sim.rs` in the disposable review tree. `issue_2441_stock_sim_models_drill_point_cone_lip_when_stopped_at_floor` failed: `got z=0.000`. I restored the code, and the test passed.
- I checked each changed line in the NC example and the two cached project examples. The four catalog cycles change from `G73 Z-1. Q18.` to `G83 Z-2.803 Q6.`. The added point length crosses the Auto cycle's 4d threshold. The router drill bottoms change to world Z `-2.802582`, or G54 Z `-14.803`. The other operation paths are unchanged. No `.cl` golden or UI snapshot PNG changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Added before and after Levels screenshots to the PR body. The after image shows `Break-through from`. Both images live only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. The selector test `drill_break_through_from_defaults_to_full_diameter_and_switches_to_tip` failed with the selector removed and passed after restoration. The body-link check failed on the old body and passed on the updated body.
2. Added a new conventional breaking-change commit for project format v68. Existing history is preserved. The body explains that readers limited to v67 or earlier refuse v68 files. Extended `v65_preserves_cutting_steps_and_loads_v63_break_through_and_v62_defaults` to pin the saved version at v68 or newer. It failed with v67 and passed after restoring v68. `wrong_version_is_refused` also passed.

New head: `f1bbbee614d5ec580c60e173cb838af5b2288ff8`.

The full quick gate passed 589/592 steps. The failures were the recorded microarc line-count failure, stock-source-holes refusal-message failure, and missing graphics adapter. Both review-fix pins passed. Strict Clippy hit the review's unchanged `heights.rs:128` warning; it passed with only that lint allowed. Full details are in the PR body.

Please re-review. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: f1bbbee614d5ec580c60e173cb838af5b2288ff8 -->
**Verdict: merge-ready**

Note: this PR merged at this head (merge commit `90e016a6e`, 2026-11-18 13:20 UTC) before this second review ended. This review is a post-merge check of the same head. The items below are follow-ups, not blockers.

**Blockers:** none.

**Safety checks (drill depth, posted G-code, stock simulation):**

- `crates/motion/src/drilling/hole.rs` `drill_point_length`: the formula is `(d/2)/tan(angle/2)`. It refuses NaN, infinity, angle `<= 0`, angle `> 180` and a zero or negative diameter by name. 180 degrees gives 0. No panic and no infinite depth. `Tool::is_sane` already keeps a drill in `(60, 180)`.
- `through_tip_run` adds the point only for `FullDiameter`, a `ToolKind::Drill`, and not for `Spot`, `Tap`, `FloatingTap` or `Ream`. Blind holes and a stated Bottom keep their depth. The depth of a blind hole does not change.
- Old files: `settle_drill_break_through` sets `Tip` for each pre-v68 Drill op. Their posted depth and their digest do not change (`0xB8` is written only for `FullDiameter`). New ops default to `FullDiameter`.
- The deeper Z goes into the `Broke` tip (stock-bottom note), into `drill_reach::axial_reach` (flute reach), and into the toolpath moves that the fixture laws read. The test `a_break_through_into_modelled_steel_under_the_stock_is_refused` shows that a full-diameter exit into a tagged spoil board holds the post. The `operations.rs` change shows that the flute-reach law refuses the deeper hole with the old 12 mm flute.
- Canned cycles: no post file changed. Only `bottom_z` moves. In the Fanuc example the Auto law now selects `G83 ... Z-2.803 Q6.` in place of `G73 ... Z-1. Q18.`, because the deeper hole crosses the 4d threshold. This is the existing Auto law, not a post change. R, F and the hole positions do not change. No `.cl` golden changed (`golden_cl` pins `Tip`).
- Stock simulation: `SdfTool::Drill` / `RevKind::Drill` put the apex at the tool tip and use `cot = 1/tan(angle/2)`. That gives a cone height `r*cot`, the same as `drill_point_length`. `drill_dist` is the exact distance to the convex cone-plus-cylinder solid. The column engine keeps its cone atom. For a vertical plunge that gives the same top surface (pinned by `drill_engines_cut_cone_with_cylindrical_flute_and_agree`). All callers pass the drill flag: rest (`rest.rs`, `across.rs`), carry walk, playback and field view. `stock_sim_marks.rs` has no flag, but it applies only to Engrave and Trace.
- MCP: `edit_operation` goes through the same JSON merge-patch and `params_from_json` door as the GUI parameter edit. An unknown value (`"shank"`) is refused.

**Process files:** none changed. No `.claude/`, `AGENTS.md`, `xtask/` or gate script is in the diff. `Process change: yes` is not necessary.

**Breaking / type:** in fact this is a breaking feat. It adds a user parameter, a UI control and an MCP field, it changes the project format (v68), and it changes the posted Z of a newly created through-hole drill op. Commit `f1bbbee61` carries `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, so the cut sees the break. But the commit type is `test`, and the code commit is `fix`. At the cut, put the changelog row under the features and the breaking changes, not under the fixes.

**Non-blockers (follow-ups):**

1. `crates/motion/src/break_through.rs` `judge` now receives the tip run. A stated Break-through of 1 mm with a 6 mm drill gives the note "through holes run 2.803 mm past the part bottom (Break-through)". The note does not agree with the value in the field. Give the stated break-through and the point length separately. (P7)
2. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:2243`: a lathe axial drill always uses `Tip`, but the Levels page shows `Break-through from: Full diameter` (the default). The control does not do what it shows. Hide it on a lathe, or show a note. The selector also shows when it has no effect: blind holes only, a stated Bottom, and Tap, Ream or Spot cycles. (P7)
3. `docs/decisions/2441-drill-point-break-through.md` item 3 says that the example projects stay byte-identical, and that MCP/script patches default to `FullDiameter`. Both examples were regenerated to `full_diameter`. A patch keeps the stored value, and only a `null` patch resets it. Correct the text. (P7)
4. `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp` has no row for `break_through` or `break_through_from` on the hole kinds. (P5)
5. Files over the 400-line limit grew more: `crates/app/src/stock_sim.rs` (471 to 491), `crates/app/src/stock_play.rs` (405 to 410), `crates/motion/src/drilling/tests.rs` (474 to 504). (P7)
6. No recorded post stream pins a `FullDiameter` drill for a post other than Fanuc (the catalog example) and grblHAL (the router test). The post code did not change, so the risk is low. (P7)

Read from the diff. Not built. Second review (safety floor) by an agent that did not write the change.

Note for the next cut: this PR is a breaking change in fact.

- The project format goes from v67 to v68.
- A new through-hole drill operation posts a deeper hole by default (`Full diameter`).
- The merge commit `90e016a6e` has no `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer, and the PR title has the type `fix`.

The release notes must list this PR under the breaking changes and the features. Follow-up issues: #2528, #2529.
